methods_quotes.q: Full-shift personal air samples and blood specimens for lead were collected from 10 of 11 employees.
Lead air sample results were compared with occupational exposure limits.
An elevated BLL was defined as ≥5 μ g/dL, the CDC adult blood lead reference level
